license_required.quote: no person shall engage in the business of money transmission in this state without a license

bond_structure.quote: The commissioner may increase the amount of the surety bond
bond_structure.note: Floor of $500,000; commissioner may raise it up to $5,000,000 based on financial condition

bond_min_usd.quote: in the amount of at least five hundred thousand dollars ($500,000)

bond_max_usd.quote: to a maximum of five million dollars ($5,000,000)

net_worth_structure.quote: a net worth of not less than five hundred thousand dollars ($500,000)

net_worth_min_usd.quote: a net worth of not less than five hundred thousand dollars ($500,000)

application_fee_usd.quote: a nonrefundable application fee in the amount of five hundred dollars ($500)
application_fee_usd.note: A separate first-year license fee of $500 ($250 if filed after March 31) is also due

renewal_fee_usd.quote: shall pay an annual renewal fee of five hundred dollars ($500)

decision_days.quote: within one hundred twenty (120) days from the date a complete application is submitted
decision_days.note: May be extended for good cause

exemptions.quote: This subtitle does not apply to:
exemptions.note: Agents of a licensee are exempt through 286.11-005(1), not 286.11-007
